items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates that Annie Ross was a replacement singer for Lionel Hampton's band in Europe, but does not describe a personal interaction or direct collaboration with her.

ctx.x: because they didn't agree on whatever conditions and the money. Ernestine Anderson quit, Elmer Gill quit, and Moon Mullins quit, the trumpet player quit, and somebody else. I can't think of who the other people were.
So when we went to Europe, Lionel Hampton had to get a replacement for the piano and the singer. So he got George Wallington on piano and Annie Ross as a singer, as a replacement for Ernestine...
